deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's deictic pointing words into a spatial description by stating that the cervix is seen alongside the endocervical canal, which is not stated in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Histologically, this is the endocervical canal here, and so you're looking at the cervix here.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and the cervix is seen alongside it

considerations.sourcePassage: You can see maybe with sharp eyes, you'll see that there's a mitotic cell here and there's one here
considerations.reason: This is a direct remark to the audience pointing at specific individual cells on a slide; its omission is allowed because the general factual point that mitotic cells occur at the basement layer is retained.

considerations.sourcePassage: The uterus is here in this diagram, and as you know, it hangs down into the vaginal canal.
considerations.reason: Resolving 'The uterus is here in this diagram' to 'as shown in the diagram. [FIGURE]' accurately captures the speaker's reference to the diagram.
